primitives.name: GSE Completion Percentage Over Expectation
primitives.verbatim_quote: ### GSE-CPOE — completion percentage over expectation - **Model version:** `gse-xcomp-v1` - **Estimator:** logistic regression (`logistic.ts` → `fitLogistic` / `predictLogistic`), method tag `"logistic-regression"`.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'passer': 'player identifier', '\\complete': 'binary indicator of completed pass', '\\hat{P}(\\complete)': 'model-predicted probability of completion', '\\mean{\\cdot}': 'per-player mean over qualifying dropbacks'}
primitives.assumptions: Logistic regression model trained on public play-by-play features including air yards, pressure proxy, field position, and formation.

reasoning_traces.think:
Each GSE metric is defined as a residual of an expected-value model fit on public play-by-play data. For CPOE, logistic regression estimates pass completion probability given contextual features like air yards and qb hit. For RYOE and xYAC, linear regressions estimate rush yards and YAC respectively. These models are fit once at load time using deterministic algorithms, ensuring reproducibility. Residuals are aggregated per player to compute over-expected rates. Validation against NGS ensures fidelity, with metrics failing if they do not correlate well enough. The system avoids copying NGS directly by treating it only as a validation oracle. Failure modes include underdetermined systems, singular matrices, or insufficient sample sizes leading to null outputs instead of unreliable estimates.
